items.item_text: California RN license
AHA BLS card
Minimum two (2) years of acute hospital clinical experience or a Masters degree in Case Management or Nursing field in lieu of 1 year experience.

Comprehensive Discharge Planning: Conduct thorough clinical and psychosocial assessments to develop and implement effective discharge plans that align with patient needs, preferences, and available community resources.

Utilization Management: Partner with the multidisciplinary team to ensure the appropriate use of hospital resources and verify that patient care progression meets established evidence-based clinical criteria.
Care Transition Excellence: Manage complex transitions to post-acute care settings, ensuring clear communication with providers to reduce gaps in care and prevent 30-day readmissions.

Patient Advocacy & Education: Serve as the primary patient advocate, addressing cultural, spiritual, and socioeconomic barriers while providing education to empower patients and families throughout their healthcare journey.
Clinical Compliance: Maintain rigorous documentation standards and deliver required patient notifications in strict adherence to hospital policies, quality standards, and healthcare regulations.
Quality Improvement: Participate in hospital-wide performance improvement initiatives to enhance the patient experience, increase operational efficiency, and drive superior clinical outcomes.
Graduate of an accreddited school of nursing.
Able to apply clinical guidelines to ensure progression of care.
Collaborate effectively with multiple stakeholders
Understand how utilization management and case management programs integrate.
Thrive in a fast paced, self-directed environment.
Ability to pass annual Inter-rater reliability test for Utilization Review product(s) used.
Must have critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Professional communication skills.
Ability to work as a team player and assist other members of the team where needed.
Knowledge of CMS standards and requirements.
Proficient in prioritizing work and delegating where indicated.
Highly organized with excellent time management skills.

Excellent customer service and presentation skills are a must Strong interpersonal and written communication skills are essential Demonstrated ability to apply analytical and problem solving skills Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks or projects
